why: Every data file the stage slice reads. The reference frames are only valid for these exact bytes (text compared with line ends as LF). scripts/sjestage-refs.mjs records their SHA-256 in manifest-<kind>.json and e2e/sjestage.spec.ts fails FIRST, before any pixel diff, when one has changed. src/data/enemies.ts is here because the stage reads each enemy's sprite key and boss flag from it. src/data/party.ts is read too, but only for the hero NAMES (no pixel), and its bio text differs between this repo and the Phaser checkout, so it is left out on purpose (tests/sjestage-parity.test.ts names it).
